Interface CommonPageInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
CommonPage, DoComplexStuff, Performable, SearchGoogle
public interface CommonPageInterface
Defines the common page-object operations used across the framework.

Implementations typically represent a browser page or a section of a page and provide reusable actions such as opening pages, interacting with elements, collecting data, and asserting page state.
